## Important

Do not report actual vulnerabilities in public GitHub issues.

If you believe you found a vulnerability, stop here and follow the private disclosure process in `SECURITY.md`. Do not include exploit details, proof-of-concept payloads, secrets, private keys, tokens, credentials, logs with sensitive data, or real user data in this issue.
